flows:
Navigate to https://www.edx.org/ then Use the locked 320 CSS pixel viewport and scroll vertically only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it".
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
At 320px width, assert the Search courses control fits within the visible width.
Activate Search courses without horizontal scrolling and verify a search field or course catalog UI appears.

remark: analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'The Search courses control fits within the visible widt
assert: At 320px width, the Search courses control fits within the visible width.
click: Clicking Search courses in the top header
analyze: Course catalog UI appears on the page.
assert: A search field or course catalog UI appears.

summary:
The request was to activate the Search courses control using a 320-pixel-wide view without horizontal scrolling.
The Search courses control was visible within the screen width and was activated.
A course search field and the “Explore top courses” catalog section appeared.
The run finished on the public edX homepage without proceeding to sign-in, registration, or payment.
